en.role: Senior AEM Full-Stack Developer · Tech Lead
en.hero_intro: Hi, I'm Fabian. I bring design, code and content together to build digital experiences people enjoy using and teams can keep growing.
en.hero_detail: Based in Buenos Aires, with project experience across LATAM, the United States and Canada.
en.portrait: Fabian Gonzalez, Sato, in a garden
en.work_intro: Content platforms, brand experiences and tools inspired by real problems.
en.letter_1: People call me Sato. I started in design and found in programming a way to bring ideas to life. I like understanding how things work, looking at them a little differently and sharing what I learn.
en.letter_2: Over more than ten years, I've gone from websites and campaigns to AEM platforms for global brands. The things I care about haven't changed: a clear experience, a fast page and a thoughtful starting point for whoever maintains it next.
